 <modelVersion>
  4.0.0
 </modelVersion>
 <parent>
  <groupId>
   org.sonatype.oss
  </groupId>

   oss-parent
  </artifactId>

   7

 <groupId>

  auto-parent

 <packaging>
  pom

 <version>
  4-SNAPSHOT
 </version>
 <name>
  Auto (Parent)
 </name>
 <description>
  A collection of code generators for Java.
 </description>
 <url>
  https://github.com/google/auto
 </url>
 <properties>
  <project.build.sourceEncoding>
   UTF-8
  </project.build.sourceEncoding>
  <java.version>
   1.6
  </java.version>
 </properties>
 <scm>
  <url>
   http://github.com/google/auto

   scm:git:git://github.com/google/auto.git
  </connection>

   scm:git:ssh://git@github.com/google/auto.git
  </developerConnection>
  <tag>
   HEAD
  </tag>
 </scm>

  <system>
   GitHub Issues
  </system>
  <url>
   http://github.com/google/auto/issues
  </url>
 </issueManagement>
 <licenses>
  <license>
   <name>
    Apache 2.0
   </name>
   <url>
    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt
   </url>
  </license>
 </licenses>
 <organization>
  <name>
   Google, Inc.
  </name>
  <url>
   http://www.google.com
  </url>
 </organization>
 <build>
  <plugins>
   <plugin>
    <groupId>
     org.apache.maven.plugins
    </groupId>
    <artifactId>
     maven-compiler-plugin
    </artifactId>
    <version>
     3.1
    </version>
    <configuration>
     <source>
      ${java.version}
     </source>
     <target>
      ${java.version}
     </target>

      -Xlint:all

     <showWarnings>
      true
     </showWarnings>
     <showDeprecation>
      true
     </showDeprecation>
    </configuration>
   </plugin>
   <plugin>
    <groupId>
     org.apache.maven.plugins
    </groupId>
    <artifactId>
     maven-checkstyle-plugin
    </artifactId>
    <version>
     2.11
    </version>
    <configuration>
     <consoleOutput>
      true
     </consoleOutput>
     <configLocation>
      checkstyle.xml
     </configLocation>
     <failOnViolation>
      false
     </failOnViolation>
    </configuration>
   </plugin>
  </plugins>
  <pluginManagement>
   <plugins>
    <plugin>
     <artifactId>
      maven-invoker-plugin
     </artifactId>
     <version>
      1.8
     </version>

   </plugins>

1. The project uses Java 11, but the parent POM (auto-parent version 3) has profile configurations
   designed for Java 8 and earlier that reference tools.jar

2. In Java 9+, tools.jar was removed and the tools are now part of the JDK module system

3. The parent POM defines profiles that set the `toolsjar` property to point to tools.jar:

   which has a system-scoped dependency on com.sun:tools that uses the ${toolsjar} property

5. When the profile activates (checking if tools.jar exists), it fails in Java 11 because
   the file doesn't exist

- auto-common (fails during dependency resolution)
- auto-factory (skipped due to common failure)
- auto-service (skipped due to common failure)
- auto-value (skipped due to common failure)

Option 1 (Recommended): Disable the profile activation for Java 11+
- Modify the parent POM profiles to only activate for Java 8 and earlier
- Add a new profile for Java 9+ that doesn't set the toolsjar property
- This allows compile-testing to handle the tools dependency appropriately for newer JDKs

Option 2: Update dependency versions
- Upgrade compile-testing to a version that supports Java 11+
- However, this may require code changes to maintain compatibility

for Java 8 and earlier versions where tools.jar exists.

BUILD FAILURE ANALYSIS FOR google/auto PROJECT
==============================================

Repository: /home/travis/build/failed/google/auto
Java Version: OpenJDK 11.0.27

ERROR SUMMARY:
--------------
The build fails with the following error:
"Could not find artifact com.sun:tools:jar:11.0.27 at specified path /usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/../lib/tools.jar"

ROOT CAUSE:
-----------
1. The project uses Java 11, but the parent POM (auto-parent version 3) has profile configurations
   designed for Java 8 and earlier that reference tools.jar

2. In Java 9+, tools.jar was removed and the tools are now part of the JDK module system

3. The parent POM defines profiles that set the `toolsjar` property to point to tools.jar:
   - default-profile: ${java.home}/../lib/tools.jar
   - mac-profile: ${java.home}/../Classes/classes.jar

4. The auto-common module depends on com.google.testing.compile:compile-testing:0.7
   which has a system-scoped dependency on com.sun:tools that uses the ${toolsjar} property

5. When the profile activates (checking if tools.jar exists), it fails in Java 11 because
   the file doesn't exist

AFFECTED MODULES:
-----------------
- auto-common (fails during dependency resolution)
- auto-factory (skipped due to common failure)
- auto-service (skipped due to common failure)
- auto-value (skipped due to common failure)

SOLUTION:
---------
There are two approaches to fix this:

Option 1 (Recommended): Disable the profile activation for Java 11+
- Modify the parent POM profiles to only activate for Java 8 and earlier
- Add a new profile for Java 9+ that doesn't set the toolsjar property
- This allows compile-testing to handle the tools dependency appropriately for newer JDKs

Option 2: Update dependency versions
- Upgrade compile-testing to a version that supports Java 11+
- However, this may require code changes to maintain compatibility

IMPLEMENTATION:
--------------
We will implement Option 1 by modifying /home/travis/.m2/repository/com/google/auto/auto-parent/3/auto-parent-3.pom
to update the profile activation conditions to exclude Java 9+.

The fix will modify the profile activation to check the JDK version and only activate
for Java 8 and earlier versions where tools.jar exists.
